commands.dogfood: runx skill skills/spam-risk-reviewer --json --input-json campaign_draft=... --input-json list_metadata=... --input-json sender_auth_posture=...

observations: low-risk-verified-sender: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC pass; bounce_rate 0.004, complaint_rate 0.0002, freshness_days 18, warm_up_days 45; verdict clears preflight.
high-risk-incomplete-auth-poor-list: DKIM does not pass; bounce_rate 0.12, complaint_rate 0.004, freshness_days 220, warm_up_days 3; verdict holds and routes to human approval.
typed inputs are campaign_draft{from, subject, content_digest}, list_metadata{size, bounce_rate, complaint_rate, freshness}, and sender_auth_posture{spf_pass, dkim_pass, dmarc_pass, warm_up_days}.
typed output includes send_risk_verdict{risk_level, preflight_clear, blockers, evidence_summary}, authentication_signals, list_hygiene_metrics, needs_human, send_as_dispatch, and authority_boundary.
authority_boundary confirms the skill emits no runx.operational_proposal.v1, mints no authority, reads no domain state, and sends no messages.
send_as_dispatch states that a separate governed send-as run owns the public_send effect and cannot satisfy preflight when blockers are present.
